kind: Published split Host Tooling adoption for existing local artifact and record owners
published_review: Archive digests match Cargo.lock; every published Rust source was byte-compared with the exact committed VCS revision. Newer dirty sibling streaming, matching, gzip, locking, path, documentation and licensing changes are excluded. No copied implementation or local dependency patch.
catalog: Compatible 0.3.0 manifest requirements; both registry resolutions locked to 0.3.0 with default-features=false. Optional archive, gzip and wasm features are not selected.

compatibility.reason: Public checksum_reader now retries Interrupted internally instead of returning the first interruption; callers must own blocking and timeouts. Impossible read byte counts reject as typed InvalidData instead of allowing an out-of-range slice panic.
compatibility.preserved: Public signatures, Backup-owned ArtifactError/PersistenceError/checksum records, v1 bytes, normalized digest values, descriptor custody and private durable publication stay intact. No upstream types are newly re-exported.
compatibility.metadata: Package/lock workspace version and released receipt stay 0.4.2; the existing fixture allocation batch is carried into the single 0.5.0 draft.
compatibility.retained_data: No record, artifact or journal reset/regeneration required; paid attempt ownership and recovery allowances are unchanged.

limits: hash_reader and copy_reader use u64::MAX, preserving the absence of a new artifact-size ceiling and using bounded working buffers. Record stream budgets retain their exact original u64 limit; conversion to representable usize saturates as before on supported 64-bit hosts. Upload chunk collection retains its original exact descriptor/seek/take extent and at most 1 MiB.
errors: Raw hashing retains original IO errors and rejects impossible counts as InvalidData; shared copying retains original source/sink IO failures and partial bytes with no complete identity on failure. No-follow reads retain NotRegularFile -> IO InvalidInput and LimitExceeded -> RecordTooLarge with original limit. Output budgets reject the whole excess buffer and preserve existing typed errors. JSON decoding is unchanged.
custody: No-follow reads reject final links and opened nonregular files; trusted ancestors and concurrent byte custody remain local. Descriptor-relative artifact traversal, UTF-8 tree framing, private 0700/0600 creation, no-replace publication, parent synchronization and original crash barriers remain local. Generic durable::write_with is not adopted because it does not preserve these private permissions and crash contracts.
msrv: Both dependencies declare Rust 1.88; Backup retains edition 2024 and Rust 1.91.
license: Published MIT dependencies used through registry APIs; no implementation copied. Existing Canic/source attribution retained.
